verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail stores users' scanned mail, so whether that data is used for AI training is a fair question for this kind of product, and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training policy or an opt-out. The privacy items found (requesting that mail not be scanned, on-site shredding, 2FA, a HIPAA BAA) are adjacent controls and do not address AI training.
